exposure: Expectant management (EM) up to 41 weeks of gestation
Elective induction of labor (e-IOL) between 40 1/7 and 40 6/7 weeks of gestation
cohort: The study included 112 Indian women with overdate pregnancies (40 1/7 to 40 6/7 weeks gestation).
finding: Expectant management in post-date pregnancies resulted in lower rates of Caesarean section compared to elective induction of labor, without negatively impacting perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Expectant management led to significantly lower rates of cesarean sections (37.5%) compared to elective induction of labor (58.9%).
gest_age: Participants were enrolled at 40 weeks of pregnancy, with exposures initiated between 40 1/7 and 40 6/7 weeks of gestation.
